Rule: a source switches on after 2+ complete fantasy weeks and 20+ of its swaps judged, with a higher swap gain per add game and a smaller miss on its own "+N" than the site's values over those weeks (pooled by swaps).
DARKO minutes: 1 complete weeks, 9 swaps: gain +3.06/g vs the site's +0.10, miss 5.87 vs 7.73.
shrunk: 1 complete weeks, 6 swaps: gain -1.90/g vs the site's +0.10, miss 9.19 vs 7.73.

Week ending 2026-11-08: site swaps +0.10/g (n=8, miss 7.73), streamers -0.62/g; DARKO minutes swaps +3.06/g (n=9, miss 5.87), streamers -1.04/g; shrunk swaps -1.90/g (n=6, miss 9.19), streamers -1.43/g.

Same mornings for all three: 16 league mornings with a DARKO reading since 2026-11-06 (state/nba_darko.json: DARKO's Time Machine as of each morning, backfilled before Nov 12, then read once a day from 7am CT; kept for my rostered players, those named by that morning's advice, and the 10 best free agents per league). The replay of the site's own values reproduces 100% of the streamers and 67% of the swaps shown.

How: each morning's picks replayed under each source with the site's rules, judged like the swaps above (league units, need-weighted, above a waiver-level player). DARKO minutes = each line rescaled to DARKO's projected minutes (darko.app; only our minutes factor is kept); shrunk = a season average pulled toward ESPN's season projection by games played (tonight's projection, not that morning's).
